notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP. The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists. Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to M+N. Additional reviewed scope: B+C+J+P+S. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained. The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists. Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to M+N. Additional reviewed scope: B+C+J+P+S. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied. The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists. Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to M+N. Additional reviewed scope: B+C+J+P+S. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed. The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists. Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to M+N. Additional reviewed scope: B+C+J+P+S. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. ADB: source AR5 GWP100 totals are converted from Gg to tonnes once. SEEA uses residence-based accounts; EDGAR uses a territorial boundary. The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists. Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to M+N. Additional reviewed scope: B+C+J+P+S. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted. Direct final-user emissions have no observed supplying-sector split and are excluded from this sector slice; they remain in the full total.
notes.value_added_trade: Upstream value added embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Domestic and Foreign identify value added generated inside or outside the exporting native region. Total includes both and can closely match gross monetary trade in balanced systems. Repeated border crossings can count the same value added again; this is not value-added exports measured by ultimate foreign final absorption. The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists. Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to M+N. Additional reviewed scope: B+C+J+P+S. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
notes.ghg_trade: Upstream production GHG embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Repeated border crossings can count the same emissions again. Direct final-user emissions and unrepresented production accounts are not allocated to traded output. ADB: source AR5 GWP100 totals are converted from Gg to tonnes once. SEEA uses residence-based accounts; EDGAR uses a territorial boundary.
